description: This file is a C header (.h) file that declares functions and includes for integrating with the Duktape JavaScript engine. It defines function prototypes related to loading/unloading JavaScript extensions and loading template files, along with include guards and external dependencies.

methods.name: ccsp_extensions_load
methods.description: Loads custom extensions into the Duktape context.

methods.name: ccsp_extensions_unload
methods.description: Unloads custom extensions from the Duktape context.

methods.name: load_template_file
methods.description: Loads the contents of a template file into a buffer.
